content.text: You’re a creator in Nigeria. You’ve written an ebook. You want to sell it online. But Stripe and PayPal are unavailable. Conventional platforms like Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy block your country. This is not a minor inconvenience. It’s a structural lock-out. The solution is not a workaround. It’s base-layer infrastructure. This post breaks down how to build a sovereign digital commerce stack. One that uses GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payments. No platform fees. No geographic restrictions. Full data ownership. This is automated digital product delivery built for the people Stripe locked out.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

This is a self-owned digital commerce stack. You host your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages — both free. The backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets. Files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payments are processed through NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. The customer pays in USDT, BTC, or any supported coin. The payment is automatically verified on-chain. The file is delivered instantly. You own every component. No platform has access to your data. No subscriptions. No recurring fees. This is infrastructure sovereignty — not renting, but owning.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The frontend is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. The backend is a serverless function — either Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. When a buyer completes a crypto payment, NOWPayments sends a webhook to your backend. The backend verifies the payment on-chain, logs the order in Supabase or Google Sheets, and generates a secure, time-limited download link. The link points to your file stored in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The buyer receives the link instantly. The entire process is automated. No manual intervention. No third-party platforms. The architecture is modular. You can swap components as needed. For example, replace Supabase with Airtable or NOWPayments with CoinGate. The core logic remains the same.

This is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, Philippines — these are the markets this stack serves. Creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. People who need to collect payment in crypto because fiat options are blocked. People who refuse to rent infrastructure from platforms that can shut them down at any time. This stack is not a workaround. It’s a permanent solution. It’s built to withstand payment rejection, currency collapse, and financial isolation. It’s pressure-tested in Zimbabwe — the hardest market on earth.
Own your infrastructure. Renting from platforms that can shut you down is not a business strategy.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provides free, reliable hosting. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic without servers. Supabase or Google Sheets stores order data securely. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files efficiently. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee and no KYC. Each component is free or low-cost. Each is independently replaceable. Together, they form a complete digital commerce stack. The stack is designed for automation. The moment a payment confirms on-chain, the file is delivered. No manual steps. No platform dependencies. The customer owns the entire stack after deployment. COREMERCH has no access. No one can shut it down.
